newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds still hampered by firm dollar.
newsitem.headline: European feeds still hampered by firm dollar.

text.p: European meals and feeds kicked off quietly on Thursday, with the firm dollar continuing to deter consumer buying.
Physical traders were offering products on the continent at roughly level prices to Wednesday, but some positions were up to a couple of dollars lower.

Very nearby positions in Argentine sunmeal attracted more than a $10 premium, as supplies remained tight. Traders noted a handful of bids just below the market for South American soymeal but there were no trades reported in early business.
